A wonderful dinner by the river
Jun 2026 • Couples
I had a wonderful dining experience at Ros Yacht Club. The restaurant offers a stunning riverside view, creating a relaxing and romantic atmosphere, especially in the evening. The food was delicious, fresh, and beautifully presented. Every dish was well-prepared and full of flavor. The staff were friendly, attentive, and provided excellent service. If you are looking for a place with great food and a beautiful view of the Saigon River, I highly recommend visiting Ros Yacht Club.

What a great restaurant
Sep 2025 • Business
Right on the riverfront this was a wonderful choice of venue for our 56 attendees. It was decorated beautifully and it was great watching the lights and the dinner cruises floatpast. They have seating inside and outside... we were seated inside and it was cool and tranquil. The food was a set menu and each course was wonderful and beautifully presented,staff were well trained and helpful. Pricing was good! I would definitely recommend this for a birthday celebration or anniversary as well.
